I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

I only looked at what Pree can see herself: the #central-team channel and the public files. Neither mentions Brackenwater at all, and I can't see any account files for it. I didn't use `search_messages`, so I didn't pull in conversations she isn't part of.

I didn't record the date anywhere, since it's an unverified tip. My reply suggests she confirm it with the account owner or the contract/CRM record before anyone plans around it. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so nothing here needed approval.

One wording slip: the reply opens with "I've noted it as unverified." That could read as if I saved it somewhere, but I didn't.
